narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**Four zones must keep `account_id`.** The rest is 94 files.

| Zone | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | 1 | Public contract. Frozen. |
| [serialize.js](lib/serialize.js:8) `WIRE` values | 1 | Public wire names. |
| [migrations/](migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql:9) | 12 | Applied history. Down step breaks. |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk/](vendor/reporting-sdk/README.md:3) | 4 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |

Also 125 SQL strings name the live column. They sit in 25 repo files. A column-rename migration must land first.

Safe now: JS names in 50 http and service files.

Next: sign off on the JS half only.
